Name: IT General Controls (ITGC) for Oracle ERP Systems
Description: IT General Controls (ITGC) framework aligned with Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404 and COSO Internal Control Framework for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, HCM, and NetSuite.

Requirements.Name: Privileged User Access Governance & Implementation Roles
Requirements.Description: Implementation consultant and superuser roles must not remain active in production Oracle ERP environments post-go-live.

Requirements.Name: Multi-Factor Authentication on Administrator and Finance Accounts
Requirements.Description: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) must be enforced for all users holding elevated, administrative, or financial transaction privileges.

Requirements.Name: User Access Reviews and Dormant Account Cleanup
Requirements.Description: Privileged accounts with no login activity for over 90 days must be reviewed, deactivated, or revoked to minimize attack surface.

Requirements.Name: Audit Trail Configuration and Sensitive Transaction Logging
Requirements.Description: Oracle Fusion ERP audit policies must be enabled and actively recording changes to financial objects, user permissions, and security configurations.

Requirements.Name: Network Perimeters and OAuth Integration Governance
Requirements.Description: ERP access must be restricted through corporate IP allowlists and OAuth Confidential Application scopes must adhere to least privilege.
